**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert at preferred level).**

- **Investigation:** Section 6 (Termination) covers only fee settlement and assignment of Works in progress (p0032–p0033, plus the stray termination-effects paragraph p0044). Section 4 addresses ownership of Works only. Section 8 confidentiality (p0038–p0040) imposes use/disclosure restrictions with no return or destruction obligation. Searches for return of materials, transition, export, and deletion returned nothing.
- **Conclusion:** No exit mechanics exist anywhere, so the fallback (90 days' assistance; export within 30 days) also fails — particularly given either party can terminate on 15 days' notice.
- **Cure:** One new paragraph 6(d): six months' transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter — numbered (d) to avoid clashing with the existing "(c)" termination paragraph, with no ancillary boilerplate added.
